svg.aria-label: Cab floor support & crew ladder brackets
svg.text: Cab floor support & crew ladder brackets
Floor underside 1775; finish 1800 retained. New beams stop at main-rail faces. Weld proposals 4mm at supports; floor 3mm intermittent 100/200.
Crew ladder has 300mm rises. Concentrated floor/tread loads, slip protection, egress and trailing-truck sweep remain unresolved.
LT4 R0 · 2026-10-19 | mm · NTS | FITS / WELDS PROVISIONAL
